Dataset title: PlantMetWiki core RDF derived from PlantCyc to WikiPathways: BioCyc flat-file to GPML2021 conversion pipeline
Notes: Core WikiPathways RDF (pathways + reactions, both typed wp:Pathway). 2,758 gene products, 3,750 enzymes, 4,577 metabolites, 54,800 typed interaction edges, 5,722 PubMed-annotated references.

Dataset title: PlantMetWiki GPML property extra RDF derived from PlantCyc to WikiPathways: BioCyc flat-file to GPML2021 conversion pipeline
Notes: PlantCyc/GPML key-value Property elements preserved as pmw:gpmlProperty. Basis for future expansion of the semantic model.

Dataset title: PlantMetWiki taxonomy extra RDF derived from PlantCyc to WikiPathways: BioCyc flat-file to GPML2021 conversion pipeline
Notes: Per-DataNode wp:organism species annotations + Viridiplantae root (NCBITaxon:33090).

Source file: ROBOT MIREOT extract from ncbitaxon.owl (not bundled as a repo file)
Notes: MIREOT subset: 424 seed taxa + ancestors, 1.4 MB, reduced from 21,719,262 triples (1.8 GB) for the full ontology. Enables cross-graph label resolution without federation.
plantiSMASH v2 pre-calculated database, 65 BGCs, Arabidopsis thaliana only.
MIBiG 4.0, 43 BGCs (9 typed Arabidopsis thaliana, 34 untyped / no species).

Self-describing data model: the pmw: vocabulary (6 terms, CC0) plus wp: (38 terms) and gpml: (87 terms) as SKOS concept schemes. All terms typed as OWL classes/properties with rdfs:label, definitions and rdfs:domain/rdfs:range. Lets a client resolve any pmw:, wp: or gpml: term in the same query that retrieves the data.
VoID and PROV-O provenance, licensing, versioning and download locations for every content graph. Concept DOI for the RDF release: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.17967619
